title: Weight of a body with its own mark against its cost

key_results.statement: Held body at $\tau=0$, both couplings, every $N_f\ge1$, lowest field state: in each sector $(x,k,\sigma)$ the eigenvalue is $\theta\sigma M_k+c_s+N_f\min\operatorname{spec}(C_1+g_bP_x+g_sP_{x_s})$, $g_b=\sigma\gamma M_k$, $\theta=1$ for (a) and $0$ for the full grip, exactly.

Lowest eigenpair of $C_1+gP_x$ on ring, square or cubic torus, exactly: $\psi(x+y)\propto1-\eta\ell_\delta(y)$ with $g/t_f=\eta/(1-\eta\ell_\delta(0))$, $\eta=|X_f|\delta/t_f$, $\operatorname{sign}\delta=\operatorname{sign}g$, $\delta/t_f<\omega_{\min}$.

Item 1, exact in $\gamma$: $\mathrm{Cost}_{k,\sigma}=\theta\sigma M_k+C^{\rm mark}_{k,\sigma}$, $C^{\rm mark}=N_f[\varepsilon_0(g_b)-\varepsilon_0(0)]=nt_f\eta(g_b)$; level and branch differences of $E$ are fixed by the total contract, $C^{\rm mark}$ as a difference between descriptions with and without the coupling, Cost only relative to the description without the body and up to a constant of the body's own term.

Both couplings, exact in $\gamma$, first order in $g_s$: $W_{k,\sigma}(x)-W_{k,\sigma}(x')=N_fg_s[\rho_{g_b}(x_s-x)-\rho_{g_b}(x_s-x')]+O(g_s^2)$, the field density made by the body read at the source.
Closed form of the weight difference, exact in $\gamma$: $\Delta W=ng_s[(1-\eta\ell_\delta(r))^2-(1-\eta\ell_\delta(r'))^2]/(1+\eta^2\ell^{(2)}_\delta/|X_f|)+O(g_s^2)$, $\eta=\eta(g_b)$.

Through $\gamma^2$, both couplings, all three graphs: $\Delta W=\sigma\gamma M_k[\delta N]+\gamma^2M_k^2[\Theta_D]+O(g_s\gamma^3M_k^3)$, $\Theta_D=(ng_s/t_f^2)[\ell^2+2\ell_0\ell-2\ell^{(2)}/|X_f|]$ at $r=x_s-x$.

Ring, exact in $r$, through $\gamma^2$: $\Delta W=\sigma\gamma M_k\frac{ng_s}{Lt_f}(u-u')+\gamma^2M_k^2\frac{ng_s}{3L^2t_f^2}[u^2-u'^2-\frac{L^2-2}{2}(u-u')]$, $u=r(L-r)$, which is (7.6); a uniform pull for $r\ll L$.
Exact in $\gamma$: $\Delta W_{k,\sigma}=\mathcal W_{x,x'}(C^{\rm mark}_{k,\sigma})+O(g_s^2)$ with one function $\mathcal W$ for all levels, both branches, every $\gamma$ and both couplings.

Full grip: $\Delta W=\mathrm{Cost}\,F\,(1+B^{\rm fg})$, universal at leading order; a level-independent factor exists at order $\gamma^2$ iff $F_2(x,x')=0$, otherwise the first breaking term is $F_2\mathrm{Cost}^2$ with $B^{\rm fg}=-\frac\eta2[\ell(r)+\ell(r')-2[\ell^{(2)}]/(|X_f|[\ell])]$, $\eta=\mathrm{Cost}/(nt_f)$.

Coupling (a): $\Delta W=\mathrm{Cost}\,F^{(a)}(1+B^{(a)})$, $F^{(a)}=\gamma[\delta N]/(1+\gamma n)$, universal at leading order; a level-independent factor exists at order $\gamma^2$ iff $[\Theta_D]=0$, otherwise the first break is $\gamma^2M_k^2[\Theta_D]$, $B^{(a)}=-\frac{g_b}{2t_f}[\ell(r)+\ell(r')+2\ell_0-2[\ell^{(2)}]/(|X_f|[\ell])]$.

First order in $\gamma$: on the ring $B^{\rm fg}\simeq-\eta L/12$, $B^{(a)}\simeq-g_bL/(6t_f)$; on the square torus both grow like $\ln L$; on the cubic torus $B^{\rm fg}\simeq-\frac{\eta}{8\pi}(\frac1{|r|}+\frac1{|r'|})+O(\eta/L)$ decays while $B^{(a)}\to-g_bG_3/t_f$, $G_3=0.252731$; only the full grip on the cubic torus gives proportionality improving with distance.

Differences of levels and branches: ratio $=\frac{C_1-C_2}{\theta(\sigma_1M_{k_1}-\sigma_2M_{k_2})+C_1-C_2}[F+F_2(C_1+C_2)+F_3(C_1^2+C_1C_2+C_2^2)+\dots]$; level pairs break at first order in $\gamma$, branch pairs at order $\gamma^2M_k^2$; on the cubic torus the full-grip branch break decays like $1/|r|$, that of (a) tends to $\gamma^2M_k^2G_3^2/t_f^2$.

Highest state, even $L$: $\Delta W^{\rm high}(g_b)=\Delta W(-g_b)=\sum_j(-1)^jF_j(C^{\rm mark,high})^j$, $C^{\rm mark,high}(g_b)=-C^{\rm mark}(-g_b)$; first-order relative breaks change sign, second-order branch-pair breaks do not.

definitions.name: shifted pseudo-inverse of the graph Laplacian
scaled shift of the lowest eigenvalue
weight as function of the mark cost
relative break and leading factor, coupling (a)

open_issues: Results for N_f > 1 rest on the reduction (4.2); the code checks N_f = 1 only.
The highest state is covered for even L only; for odd L the top of the band is degenerate and not treated.
Terms of order g_s² (the source's own mark and its nonlinearity) are not treated.
The lattice constants c_□, G_3 and ξ_3 are evaluated numerically, not in closed form.
On the square and cubic tori the pairs where F_2 or [Θ_D] vanish are not classified.
Whether a coupling other than the full grip removes the G_3 break of (a), and how special the full grip is, belongs to item 5; moving bodies, inertia and bonds are out of scope.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of cost, weight, F, F_2, F_3 and of every term of (3.5), (3.8), (3.13)-(3.17)
γ → 0 limit; ring: (3.5) reduces to (6.7), (3.8) to (7.6) and to the g_1²g_2 term of (4.8)
Sum rule: the γ-dependent part of the sum of W over all places of the body vanishes at orders γ and γ²
